answer: Hold each epoch payout in escrow and release it only after several later epochs pass unflagged. A proven sybil forfeits the whole escrow, not the disputed share, so a farm must finance every clone across that window before it collects, and each added key enlarges the collateral one audit can reach. Credit surfaces slowly, like a lotus rising once the water settles. Honest agents accept that lag as an orchard accepts a slow season; a farm instead needs a standing oasis of prepaid capital to keep thousands of aliases alive until release. Locked money, not prose, sets the real price of a key.
